BiblicalUsage: Epichoregia is supply, contribution — the supply of every joint in the body, by which it grows in love; and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ, by which Paul's bonds turn to salvation.
TheologicalSignificance: The church grows by supply, not by strain, I believe: every joint furnishing its part, and the Spirit furnishing His.
RelatedTopics: Church; Unity; Outpouring of the Spirit
